# Account Deletion & Plant Club

When you delete your account, your **Plant Club subscription is automatically cancelled** as part of the deletion process.

Here's what you should know:

## Plant Club Details
- If you've already been **charged for the next month's box** (Plant Club charges on the **25th** of the previous month), that box will **still be sent** — it won't be refunded just because you've cancelled.
- Any boxes that haven't shipped yet will be cancelled and not sent.

## Account Deletion Process
- You can delete your account yourself from **"Account" > "Privacy"** on the website or app.
- Deletion takes up to **30 days** to fully process.

## What I'd Recommend
Before deleting, check:
1. **When does your Plant Club charge next?** If it's before the 25th of this month, you might want to cancel the subscription first (from "Account" > "Subscriptions") to avoid an unnecessary charge.
2. **Any pending orders?** Make sure there's nothing in progress you need to handle.

If you want to **cancel just the Plant Club without deleting your whole account**, you can do that anytime from "Subscriptions" — no fee or notice needed.

Is there anything else about the deletion or subscription cancellation I can help clarify?
